exposure: types of radiation therapy (e.g., prophylactic cranial irradiation, involved field radiation therapy, involved site radiation therapy, craniospinal irradiation, total body irradiation)
use of radiation therapy for limb sparing
use of general anesthesia for young children receiving radiation therapy
outcome: changes in radiation therapy administration practices
cohort: 122 children (<18 years) with cancer who underwent radiation therapy (128 courses) at St. John's Hospital in Bengaluru, India, between 2013 and 2024.
finding: The institution successfully implemented evolving standard of care changes in radiation therapy administration for children with cancer over the last decade, aiming to minimize late effects without an obvious negative impact on overall survival.
